title: Are Vision Language Models Cross-Cultural Theory of Mind Reasoners?
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark, CulturalToM-VQA, to evaluate Vision Language Models on their ability to perform cross-cultural Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning. A core component of this benchmark is evaluating the model's understanding of 'social norm violations' and culturally grounded intentions and beliefs. This directly assesses a form of moral and ethical reasoning as it is manifested in social contexts across diverse cultures. The evaluation is not a peripheral ethical consideration but a central part of the research contribution.
